evidence: Verified against the four official source HDF5 tasks by replaying saved MuJoCo states. RGB-D/calibration at index t are pre-action and align with action[t]; copied 8-D state[t] is post-action, so the adapter uses state[t-1] and drops frame zero. Both simulator cameras require flip_y. Official get_real_depth_map output matches stored metric depth; K/T match the replayed simulator. PandaGripper source defines -1 open and +1 closed.

temporal_indexing.rgb_depth_calibration_action: index t at saved pre-action MuJoCo state
temporal_indexing.processed_state: index t is post-action; use state[t-1] with visual/action index t
